# FrameAssembly

> A Domain-Specific Language (DSL) for writing deterministic network traffic to `.pcap` files.

## Overview
FrameAssembly compiles a custom networking DSL (with the `.fasm` extension) into reproducible PCAPNG (`.pcap`) files. It uses a strict, keyword-oriented syntax designed for network engineers, security researchers, and LLM-driven traffic generation.

## Architecture & Folder Structure
- `src/lib.rs`: Library crate root and module exports.
- `src/main.rs`: Entry point handling CLI execution (`frameassembly <file.fasm>`).
- `src/lexer.rs`: Zero-copy tokenizer built using `logos`.
- `src/parser.rs`: Combinator-based AST parser built using `winnow`.
- `src/ast.rs`: Abstract Syntax Tree definitions for `HostDef`, `FlowDef`, `FrameStatement`, and `Program`.
- `src/pcap.rs`: Handles writing packets to PCAPNG format using `pcap-file`.
- `src/packet.rs` & `src/backend.rs`: Handles packet encapsulation (L2-L4) via `etherparse` and AST evaluation.
- `src/snmp_builder.rs` & `src/snmp_crypto.rs`: Full RFC 1157 (SNMPv1), RFC 3416 (SNMPv2c), RFC 3414 (SNMPv3 USM + DES-CBC), RFC 3826 (AES-128-CFB), and RFC 7860 (HMAC-SHA-2) packet construction.
- `examples/`: Contains 105 annotated `.fasm` training examples (`01_...` through `105_...`) with `// PROMPT:`, `// TOKENS:`, and `// INSTRUCTION:` metadata.

## Complete DSL Keyword Reference
- **Top-Level Blocks:** `HOST`, `FLOW`, `COMPILE`, `LOOP`
- **Host Properties:** `IP <ipv4>`, `MAC <xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx>` (optional, defaults to `00:00:00:00:00:00`)
- **Direction Operators:** `->` (left-to-right), `<-` (right-to-left)
- **Protocols:** `TCP`, `UDP`, `SNMP1`, `SNMP2`, `SNMP3`
- **Ports:** `SRCPORT <u16>`, `DSTPORT <u16>`
- **TCP Flags (at least 1 required for `TCP`):** `SYN`, `ACK`, `FIN`, `RST`, `PSH`, `URG`, `ECE`, `CWR`
- **TCP Fields:** `SEQ <u32>`, `ACKNUM <u32>`, `WIN <u16>`, `PAYLOAD "<string>"`
- **Timing:** `WAIT <u32><ms|s|m>`
- **SNMP PDU Types:** `TRAP` (default), `INFORM`, `GET`, `GETNEXT`, `GETBULK`, `SET`, `RESPONSE`
- **SNMP Common Fields:** `COMMUNITY "<string>"`, `OID <oid|"<oid>">`, `SYSUPTIME <u32>`, `REQID <u32>`, `NONREPEATERS <u32>`, `MAXREPETITIONS <u32>`
- **SNMPv1 Trap Fields:** `ENTERPRISE <oid|"<oid>">`, `AGENTIP <ipv4>`, `GENTRAP <0..6>`, `SPECTRAP <u32>`
- **SNMPv3 USM Fields:** `USER "<string>"`, `ENGINEID "<hex>"`, `ENGINEBOOTS <u32>`, `ENGINETIME <u32>`, `CONTEXTNAME "<string>"`, `AUTH <MD5|SHA|SHA256|SHA384|SHA512> "<password>"`, `PRIV <DES|AES> "<password>"`
- **SNMP Variable Bindings (`VARBIND <oid> <TYPE> <value>`):**
  - `NULLVAL` (SNMPv2c/v3)
  - `STRING "<text>"`
  - `INT <i32>` (supports positive and negative integers, e.g. `-18`)
  - `TIMETICKS <u32>`
  - `IPVAL <ipv4>`
  - `OIDVAL <oid|"<oid>">`
  - `COUNTER32 <u32>`
  - `GAUGE32 <u32>`
  - `COUNTER64 <u64>` (SNMPv2c/v3)

## Syntax Guide & Quick Example
```frameassembly
// PROMPT: Establish a TCP handshake and send SNMPv2c/v3 traps in a loop.
// TOKENS: HOST, IP, MAC, FLOW, ->, <-, TCP, SYN, ACK, PAYLOAD, SNMP2, SNMP3, TRAP, COMMUNITY, USER, ENGINEBOOTS, ENGINETIME, AUTH, SHA256, PRIV, AES, OID, SYSUPTIME, VARBIND, INT, COUNTER64, COMPILE, LOOP

// INSTRUCTION: Define network endpoints.
HOST example_server { IP 10.0.10.5 MAC aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff }

// INSTRUCTION: Define the NMS receiver.
HOST example_nms { IP 10.0.10.100 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define sequence of TCP packet transmissions.
FLOW tcp_handshake(client, server) {
    client -> server TCP SYN PAYLOAD "Hello"
    client <- server TCP SYN ACK PAYLOAD "World"
    client -> server TCP ACK PAYLOAD "!"
}

// INSTRUCTION: Define SNMPv2c/v3 traps with custom VarBinds and USM cryptography.
FLOW snmp_alert(agent, nms) {
    agent -> nms SNMP2 TRAP COMMUNITY "public" OID "1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3" SYSUPTIME 1000 VARBIND 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.1.1 INT -12
    agent -> nms SNMP3 TRAP USER "admin" ENGINEBOOTS 1 ENGINETIME 100 AUTH SHA256 "authpass" PRIV AES "privpass" VARBIND 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.10.1 COUNTER64 123456789
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile block to execute flows.
COMPILE {
    LOOP 10 {
        tcp_handshake(example_server, example_nms)
        snmp_alert(example_server, example_nms)
    }
}
```

## Examples Corpus (`examples/*.fasm`)

### Core & Foundational (`01`–`05`)
- [examples/01_tcp_syn_flood.fasm](examples/01_tcp_syn_flood.fasm) - TCP SYN flood attack in a 1000-iteration loop with 1ms intervals
- [examples/02_udp_dns_simulation.fasm](examples/02_udp_dns_simulation.fasm) - UDP DNS query and response on port 53
- [examples/03_snmp_trap_storm.fasm](examples/03_snmp_trap_storm.fasm) - SNMPv2c linkDown trap storm in a 50-iteration loop
- [examples/04_tcp_3_way_handshake.fasm](examples/04_tcp_3_way_handshake.fasm) - Standard TCP 3-way handshake with explicit SEQ and ACKNUM on port 443
- [examples/05_complex_enterprise_network.fasm](examples/05_complex_enterprise_network.fasm) - Multi-host HTTP and SNMPv3 enterprise scenario

### TCP Flags, Handshakes, Scans & Application Protocols (`06`–`25`)
- [examples/06_tcp_graceful_fin_teardown.fasm](examples/06_tcp_graceful_fin_teardown.fasm) - 4-way TCP FIN-ACK connection teardown
- [examples/07_tcp_rst_connection_abort.fasm](examples/07_tcp_rst_connection_abort.fasm) - Abrupt TCP RST ACK connection abort with zero window
- [examples/08_tcp_psh_ack_interactive_ssh.fasm](examples/08_tcp_psh_ack_interactive_ssh.fasm) - Interactive SSH session on port 22 with PSH ACK payloads
- [examples/09_tcp_urg_out_of_band_data.fasm](examples/09_tcp_urg_out_of_band_data.fasm) - Out-of-band Telnet interrupt using URG PSH ACK flags
- [examples/10_tcp_ecn_congestion_negotiation.fasm](examples/10_tcp_ecn_congestion_negotiation.fasm) - Explicit Congestion Notification (SYN, ECE, CWR, ACK)
- [examples/11_tcp_xmas_tree_stealth_scan.fasm](examples/11_tcp_xmas_tree_stealth_scan.fasm) - Nmap Xmas tree stealth scan (FIN PSH URG)
- [examples/12_tcp_fin_stealth_scan.fasm](examples/12_tcp_fin_stealth_scan.fasm) - Bare TCP FIN stealth port scan
- [examples/13_tcp_ack_firewall_rule_probe.fasm](examples/13_tcp_ack_firewall_rule_probe.fasm) - Unsolicited TCP ACK firewall rule probe
- [examples/14_tcp_syn_ack_reflection_amplification.fasm](examples/14_tcp_syn_ack_reflection_amplification.fasm) - Reflected SYN-ACK flood and RST responses
- [examples/15_tcp_zero_window_probe_and_recovery.fasm](examples/15_tcp_zero_window_probe_and_recovery.fasm) - Zero window (WIN 0) advertisement, probe, and WIN 65535 recovery
- [examples/16_tcp_all_eight_flags_kamikaze.fasm](examples/16_tcp_all_eight_flags_kamikaze.fasm) - All 8 TCP flags enabled simultaneously (SYN ACK FIN RST PSH URG ECE CWR)
- [examples/17_tcp_simultaneous_open_handshake.fasm](examples/17_tcp_simultaneous_open_handshake.fasm) - RFC 793 simultaneous TCP open handshake
- [examples/18_tcp_keepalive_long_idle_session.fasm](examples/18_tcp_keepalive_long_idle_session.fasm) - Long idle TCP connection using `ms`, `s`, and `m` WAIT units
- [examples/19_tcp_retransmission_and_duplicate_ack.fasm](examples/19_tcp_retransmission_and_duplicate_ack.fasm) - Triple duplicate ACK and TCP fast retransmission
- [examples/20_tcp_http_post_json_api.fasm](examples/20_tcp_http_post_json_api.fasm) - Complete HTTP/1.1 POST JSON authentication flow
- [examples/21_tcp_smtp_email_submission.fasm](examples/21_tcp_smtp_email_submission.fasm) - SMTP email submission dialog on port 587
- [examples/22_tcp_ftp_control_and_passive_mode.fasm](examples/22_tcp_ftp_control_and_passive_mode.fasm) - FTP login and PASV negotiation on port 21
- [examples/23_tcp_redis_resp_cache_lookup.fasm](examples/23_tcp_redis_resp_cache_lookup.fasm) - Redis RESP cache SET/GET pipeline on port 6379
- [examples/24_tcp_bgp_peer_open_and_keepalive.fasm](examples/24_tcp_bgp_peer_open_and_keepalive.fasm) - BGP-4 eBGP peering on TCP port 179
- [examples/25_tcp_mqtt_iot_telemetry_publish.fasm](examples/25_tcp_mqtt_iot_telemetry_publish.fasm) - IoT MQTT broker CONNECT and QoS 1 PUBLISH loop on port 1883

- [examples/101_multi_loop_staged_load_test.fasm](examples/101_multi_loop_staged_load_test.fasm) - Multi-stage warm-up, peak burst, and cool-down `LOOP` blocks
- [examples/102_multi_arg_flow_mesh_orchestration.fasm](examples/102_multi_arg_flow_mesh_orchestration.fasm) - 5-host parameter east-west mesh orchestration flow
- [examples/103_bidirectional_asymmetric_port_routing.fasm](examples/103_bidirectional_asymmetric_port_routing.fasm) - Automatic TCP sequence advancement across variable payloads
- [examples/104_snmp_tri_version_coexistence_audit.fasm](examples/104_snmp_tri_version_coexistence_audit.fasm) - Coexisting SNMPv1, SNMPv2c, and SNMPv3 compliance audit
- [examples/105_minimal_single_frame_baseline.fasm](examples/105_minimal_single_frame_baseline.fasm) - Minimal single-frame baseline example
